title: Field Measurement of Age of Information: replication package (code and notebooks)
description: Code, notebooks, stored results and figures for the study of Age of Information in operational U-space surveillance and its cost for tactical UAS conflict detection. Contains the telemetry_freshness Python package, thirteen analysis notebooks, and the test suite enforcing the study's scientific controls. The four source datasets (BUBBLES, IDF-DS, ICMCIS, U-AGREE) are third-party and not redistributed; see docs/DATASETS.md.
